title: Triple Hills: the Valkyrie against the Taichou
lede: The Runeforge Directorate's new Valkyrie army against a Taichou's ashigaru, oni and Gashadokuro, on Triple Hills. The closest of six: Kusanagi no Tsurugi destroyed the Directorate's HQ in Round 1, and the battle went to Round 6, where both armies crossed 30 VP at the same scoring and the Valkyrie's Army won 33 to 32. Over the six battles it won 5 to 1, on average 28.0 VP to 22.7.
result_line: Valkyrie's Army wins on Victory Points, 33 to 32
deployment:
The Directorate set up along row 12: the Valkyrie leading her Shieldmaidens at (5,12), the Hersir with Corporaider Squad 1 at (9,12), Corporaider Squad 2 on the west at (3,12), Odin's Einherjar on the east at (11,12), the Runesmith behind at (11,14) and the HQ at (7,13). Nihon set up on rows 1 and 2: the Taichou with Ashigaru Riflemen 1 at (5,2), the War Onmyoji with Ashigaru Riflemen 2 at (3,2), the Oni Samurai at (9,2), the Armored Gashadokuro at (11,1) and the Kitsune Shinobi on the east edge at (14,2).

The Valkyrie and her Shieldmaidens are HOVER units. They started on the ground and stayed there: the AI has no rule for changing altitude, so they fought the whole battle as MOVE 3 infantry.

1.title: The sword falls on the HQ

feed.text: Both armies spend 2 CP on Double Time (Corporaider Squad 2, Ashigaru Riflemen 2); neither move needed it. Missions: FORWARD PRESENCE for the Directorate, FOCUSED FIRE for Nihon. The Directorate's Primary is RAISE THE STANDARD, planted at (4,9); Nihon's is ERADICATE THE FOE.

Nihon opens with Kusanagi no Tsurugi on (8,12): the blast catches the HQ at (7,13) and destroys it (8 HP), and leaves the Hersir and Corporaider Squad 1 SUPPRESSED. In Seize the Ground a lost HQ is not a lost battle, so the battle goes on. Every unit then Advances: Ashigaru Riflemen 2 onto the centre (6,6), the Kitsune Shinobi to the east objective (13,6), Corporaider Squad 2 to the west (2,6).
Nothing is in reach.
Nihon holds the centre and the east, the Directorate the west. Taichou's Army 5, Valkyrie's Army 2.
Nihon requisitions a third Ashigaru squad at (5,2). The Directorate spends 2 CP on Rally Cry for Corporaider Squad 1.

The Oni Samurai charge Corporaider Squad 2 on the west; the Corporaiders' Overwatch takes 4 HP off the new Ashigaru, and they Fall Back to (1,6), still inside the Objective Area. The Valkyrie and her Shieldmaidens charge onto the centre at (7,7); Ashigaru Riflemen 2 breaks away in disorder (a model lost) to (4,5).
Ashigaru Riflemen 1 and the War Onmyoji shoot the Shieldmaidens: one Shieldmaiden falls.
The Directorate holds the centre and the west, Nihon the east. 7 each.
Nihon gives the Taichou Double Time (it bought nothing). Missions: COMMAND AUTHORITY for the Directorate, DEEP REACH for Nihon.

Odin's Einherjar charge the Kitsune Shinobi on the east objective; the Shinobi Fall Back to (14,8). Nihon answers in the centre: the Oni Samurai charge in at (6,6) and Ashigaru Riflemen 2 with the War Onmyoji at (6,7). Corporaider Squad 1's Overwatch takes 2 HP off Ashigaru Riflemen 1.

The Valkyrie strikes the Onmyoji's squad for 4. The Oni Samurai destroy the Shieldmaidens and wound the Valkyrie. Corporaider Squad 1 shoots the Taichou's squad for 6. IRON CURTAIN (completed earlier in the round) and COMMAND AUTHORITY score 4 VP for the Directorate; ERADICATE THE FOE (the Shieldmaidens, in the centre) and DEEP REACH score 5 for Nihon.
Nihon holds the centre; the Directorate the west and the east. 15 each.

4.title: The second sword, and the Einherjar's kill

feed.text: A second Kusanagi no Tsurugi, on (8,6): Corporaider Squad 1 and the Hersir lose 2 HP and are PARALYZED, -1 MS and BS. The Armored Gashadokuro charges Corporaider Squad 2 on the west. Odin's Einherjar charge the Kitsune Shinobi again; Nihon's Countercharge (3 CP) with Ashigaru Riflemen 1 fails to land.

The Einherjar destroy the Kitsune Shinobi. The Valkyrie takes 6 more HP off the Onmyoji's squad. The Gashadokuro takes 4 HP off Corporaider Squad 2 and loses 2. Corporaider Squad 1 and the Runesmith shoot the Ashigaru for 6. Nihon completes IRON GRIP (7 OC on the centre), +2 VP.
Nihon holds the centre, the Directorate the west and the east. Taichou's Army 20, Valkyrie's Army 19.
Nihon requisitions another Ashigaru squad and gives Ashigaru Riflemen 1 Double Time; that move needed it.

The Valkyrie takes 4 more HP off the Onmyoji's squad; the Oni Samurai wound her. Corporaider Squad 2 and the Gashadokuro trade 4 HP for 2 on the west. Corporaider Squad 1 shoots an Ashigaru squad for 4.
The Directorate holds the centre and the east and keeps every enemy out of its half (BAR THE GATES, +2); the Gashadokuro holds the west for Nihon. Valkyrie's Army 26, Taichou's Army 22.

6.title: Both over the line, one VP apart

feed.text: Both sides spend 2 CP on Rally Cry. Both keep SECURE THE FLANKS.
Corporaider Squad 2 Falls Back from the Gashadokuro to (0,6), and the Gashadokuro charges after it. Odin's Einherjar charge onto (12,6).

The Valkyrie destroys Ashigaru Riflemen 2 and wounds the War Onmyoji. The Gashadokuro destroys Corporaider Squad 2, in the west Objective Area: ERADICATE THE FOE again. Corporaider Squad 1 shoots Ashigaru Riflemen 1 for 6.

The Directorate scores the centre and the east and SECURE THE FLANKS: 7 VP. Nihon scores the west, ERADICATE THE FOE, SECURE THE FLANKS and OMNIPRESENCE: 10 VP. Both pass 30 at the same scoring and the higher total wins. Valkyrie's Army 33, Taichou's Army 32.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.html:
The Directorate wins on ground

Valkyrie's Army won 5 of the 6 battles, on average 28.0 VP to 22.7. The gap is objectives, 19.2 to 12.8 a battle; the Primary went the other way (1.7 to 3.0) and the secondaries were even (7.2 to 6.8). The Directorate dealt more than twice the damage (59.0 a battle against 26.8) and lost less (34.5 RP against 59.2). Its one loss was the shortest battle, on Crossroads: Nihon held two objectives from Round 1 and reached 31 VP in Round 3 while neither side lost a unit, an objective race the Directorate's MOVE 3 infantry never caught.

{{batch}}{{chart:batch-vp}}{{chart:batch-sources}}

Who scored

The Directorate's Corporaider Squads (22 RP, 18 squads with requisitions) scored 4.1 VP a squad, 18.8 per 100 RP, and 55 objective VP hinged on them; Odin's Einherjar (38 RP) 5.8 a battle, and they were never destroyed. The Valkyrie (50 RP) scored 2.3 a battle, 4.5 per 100 RP, and her Shieldmaidens (30 RP) 2.2, destroyed in 2 of 6. For Nihon, the Kitsune Shinobi (22 RP) scored 3.8 a battle, 17.0 per 100 RP, but were destroyed in 5 of 6; the Ashigaru Riflemen (15 RP, 22 squads) 2.4 a squad. Its heavy pieces scored 3.5 to 3.7 a battle, 6.7 (Gashadokuro, 55 RP) and 8.7 (Oni Samurai, 40 RP) per 100 RP.

{{chart:batch-unit-vp}}{{chart:batch-unit-vp-rp}}

What the AI did with them

  • The HOVER units never left the ground. The Valkyrie and the Shieldmaidens changed altitude 0 times in 6 battles: the AI has no rule for CHANGE ALTITUDE. In air mode they would move 5, be hit at -1 and charge over a screen; on the ground they walk 3. The Directorate's 50-RP and 30-RP units were its least productive per RP.
  • Kusanagi, every time. Nihon activated a Regalia 11 times: Kusanagi no Tsurugi 9 times (Round 1 in five battles), Yata no Kagami twice, Yasakani no Magatama never. The three share one pool and the AI spends it at the first that clears its bar, which is the Command or Movement Phase one, never the Action Phase one.
  • The Taichou stood idle 4.5 Battle Rounds a battle with APt to spend, every one marked no legal action: its only weapon is a pair of katanas, and the Ashigaru squad it leads shoots and never charges, so it never has an enemy beside it. Odin's Einherjar were idle 3.7 rounds a battle, most of them holding the east objective.
  • RAISE THE STANDARD scored nothing in the featured battle. The AI planted the standard at (4,9) and never ended a round with a unit beside it.
{{chart:batch-unit-inaction}}

Double Time

Over this batch and Ramesses against Saladin, Double Time was used 53 times. 26 of the moves it went on needed it. 20 were Advances or Charges whose dice reached the square anyway: a decision on the odds that the roll made unnecessary, which the record counts as bought nothing. 7 were real waste: 5 on a unit that then did not move and 2 on a walk already in reach. In the 199 uses studied this morning, before the change, 82 were needed.

How sure

Five to one is a clear result for six battles, and the losses say why: the Directorate traded better (it lost less, it dealt more) and held ground longer. The one battle it lost was decided before the fighting started. Two AI gaps cost it: HOVER units that never fly, and a Primary it planted and forgot.

closing: The HOVER rule is the Directorate's identity, and the AI does not use it. Give the AI a CHANGE ALTITUDE decision, then play this matchup again. A RAISE THE STANDARD that the AI plants and never guards is worth a look too: it needs a missive toward the standard.
